WHAT THE SERVICE COVERS

Why dedicated landing pages are essential.

When you pay for ad clicks, you cannot afford to have visitors get lost on a slow or confusing website. A dedicated landing page focuses entirely on facilitating a buying decision.

01 / STRUCTURE

Conversion-focused structure

Visitors are not distracted by wide menus or unrelated services: the page focuses purely on a quote request or phone call.

02 / SPEED

Mobile-first and fast implementation

Over 75% of local traffic comes from smartphones. The page loads instantly and remains effortless to use on any screen size.

03 / TRUST

Credible trust-building elements

High-resolution photos of real completed work, clear warranty terms, transparent pricing ranges and authentic client proof.

PRACTICAL BUDAPEST EXAMPLES

Focused landing pages for specific services.

When prospects find an exact match to the problem they clicked on, trust is established immediately. These scenarios demonstrate the power of conversion-focused landing pages.

EXAMPLE 01 · DISTRICT XI

Aesthetic dentistry

Starting point: Traffic directed to the general practice homepage converted at just 1.2% due to cluttered navigation and sluggish mobile loading.

Actions taken: Building a dedicated 1.1-second landing page featuring clear pricing packages, procedural milestones and an instant appointment form.

Outcome: Conversion rate surged to 4.8%, while cost per qualified patient consultation dropped by more than half.

EXAMPLE 02 · DISTRICTS XIII & IV

Industrial epoxy flooring

Starting point: Commercial facility managers struggled to find technical load specifications on the generic website and bounced without requesting quotes.

Actions taken: Structured industrial landing page focusing on square metre pricing models, technical certifications and verified warehouse case studies.

Outcome: Securing 8 to 10 qualified on-site survey requests each month for large-scale logistics halls and underground parking facilities.

EXAMPLE 03 · DISTRICTS II & XII

Premium landscape architecture

Starting point: Peak spring campaign traffic overwhelmed administration with inquiries for minor lawn patches unsuitable for the team's scale.

Actions taken: Dedicated Buda hillside villa garden page showcasing complete projects, automated irrigation packages and direct call links.

Outcome: Booking out the team's entire spring and summer project capacity within three weeks from targeted residential zones.

BOUNDARIES AND TRANSPARENCY

Technical framework and hosting

We do not build bloated or slow pages. Our landing pages are built with clean code, allowing them to sit smoothly on your existing domain or subdomain without altering your main website. The primary objective is eliminating wasted ad spend.

Frequently asked questions

Do we need to replace our current business website?

No. A dedicated landing page operates alongside your main website on a subfolder or subdomain, created specifically for campaign traffic.

Why should we not send ad clicks to our homepage?

A general homepage contains too many competing navigation choices. Visitors get distracted and leave without taking action.

What technology do you use?

Clean, modern static code (HTML, CSS, JS) without slow plugins or heavy CMS overhead, ensuring fast load times even on mobile connections.

How do we measure performance?

Every button tap, phone call click and form submission is recorded as a conversion event in your campaign dashboard.

How quickly can a new landing page be deployed?

Following approval of the copy brief and layout structure, full coding, responsive testing and analytics integration are completed within 5 to 7 working days.

How does the landing page integrate with our domain?

The page can be deployed under a dedicated folder (e.g. yourdomain.hu/offer/) or a subdomain (e.g. quote.yourdomain.hu), providing a seamless, trusted user experience.
